  {T : I → Type uT} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype Θ] [(i : I) → Fintype (A i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (A i)]
  [(i : I) → Fintype (T i)] [(i : I) → DecidableEq (T i)] {E : I → Type uE} [(i : I) → Fintype (E i)]
  [(i : I) → DecidableEq (E i)] (π : Θ → ((i : I) → T i) → Real) (σ : Θ → ((i : I) → T i) → ((i : I) → A i) → Real)
  (q : Θ → ((i : I) → T i) → ((i : I) → E i) → Real) (β : (i : I) → T i → E i → A i → Real)
  (hπ : BayesCorrelated.IsInformation π) (hq : BayesCorrelated.IsExpansion π q) :
  Iff (BayesCorrelated.Induces π σ q β)
    (∀ (θ : Θ) (t : (i : I) → T i) (a : (i : I) → A i),
      LT.lt 0 (π θ t) →
        Eq
          (HDiv.hDiv (Finset.sum Finset.univ fun e => HMul.hMul (q θ t e) (BayesCorrelated.strategyProduct β t e a))
            (π θ t))
          (σ θ t a))
name: BayesCorrelated.induces_iff_positive_support
